name: Omni-Bar
description: A configurable toolbar for OBS Studio.
long_description: A configurable toolbar for OBS Studio. It docks to any edge of the main window and holds buttons that drive OBS or your sources — streaming, recording, replay buffer, virtual camera, studio mode, source visibility, filters and source hotkeys — alongside live readouts of what OBS is doing, with the bar and everything on it styled to taste.
